title: Princeton Allsearch error envelope
description: Error body returned by the Princeton University Library Allsearch API. Not RFC 9457; a nested object carrying a machine-readable problem code and a human message. Derived from a live 400 response on 2026-08-19.

problem.description: Machine-readable problem code. Observed value: QUERY_IS_EMPTY. Princeton publishes no enumeration of the full set, so this is not constrained here.

examples: The query param must contain non-whitespace characters.
